course_name: 人機互動與產品設計研究專題
outline:
人機互動設計領域牽涉廣泛，於產品設計領域中亦有相當多應用於著墨，在本課程中將以實際案例以及產品設計進行深入研究與討論。
Human-Computer Interaction Design are included variable fields. There are also a lot of applications in product design field. This course gives an overview of how Interaction Design can lead to more product design possibilities by case studies and projects.
